exposure: Severity of cholestasis (serum bile acid levels)
cohort: Pregnant women with > 28 weeks gestation attending ANC, OPD and labor room of J.N.M.C.H, AMU, Aligarh UP (India) from 2020 to 2022, divided into 200 women with IHCP and 200 healthy pregnant women.
finding: A statistically significant association was observed between IHCP and the development of GDM and pre-eclampsia, with higher odds at raised serum bile acid levels.
mod_finding: Induction and cesarean rates were significantly higher in the IHCP group.
